name: Calculus (example)
handbook:
Example module: Calculus
Contents: sequences and series, limits, differential and integral calculus in one variable.
Learning goals: students compute derivatives and integrals reliably and choose the right method.
Exam: written exam, 90 minutes.

name: Mechanics (example)
handbook:
Example module: Engineering mechanics
Contents: forces and moments, equilibrium, support reactions, centre of mass.
Learning goals: students draw free-body diagrams and compute support reactions of planar systems.
Exam: written exam, 90 minutes.

name: Chemistry (example)
handbook:
Example module: General chemistry
Contents: atomic structure, periodic table, chemical bonding, stoichiometry, acids and bases.
Exam: written exam, 60 minutes.
